checks.after: At that time one black dragon and one white dragon appeared on Long Mountain; Huang personally led his officials to observe them from more than two hundred paces away and offered a sacrifice (source wording 祭乙太宰 remains uncertain and is not silently emended).
checks.reason: 去龍二百餘步 is a distance of more than two hundred paces and 親率群僚觀之 is observing; the anomalous 祭乙太宰 is properly left unresolved, with no silent 太牢 emendation.

checks.after: At the time there were one black dragon and one white dragon, which appeared on Long Mountain; Huang personally led the group of officials to observe them at a distance of more than two hundred paces from the dragons, and performed a sacrifice (anomalous source wording 祭乙太宰 left unresolved; not read as a grand-boar offering or silent 太牢 emendation).
checks.reason: Literal correctly fixes the distance and observation and stops rendering the anomalous 祭乙太宰 as a grand-boar offering, without emending the Chinese.

checks.after: Herding oxen were given to poor families to till fields in the royal park; the state took eight-tenths, and two-tenths went to the private holders.
checks.reason: 公收其八，二分入私 gives the public eight-tenths and the private holders two-tenths; the old 'split with the state' left the owners of the shares unclear.

checks.after: Those who had oxen but no land also tilled the park; the state took seven-tenths, and three-tenths went to the private holders.
checks.reason: 公收其七，三分入私 needs explicit public seven-tenths and private three-tenths, and 有牛而無地 is correctly kept as having oxen but no land.

checks.after: he clothes the cold and feeds the hungry so that every household is provided for and every person has enough.
checks.reason: 家給人足 pairs household provision with individual sufficiency; the old en dropped 人足, and the replacement restores it faithfully.

checks.after: Agricultural officers are carefully selected and encouragement and assessment are pressed to the utmost, so each man tends a full hundred mu without borrowing oxen;
checks.reason: 高選 is careful selection, not high-ranking officers, and 勸課 covers both encouragement and assessment; the rest of the clause is preserved.

checks.after: those who labor in the fields receive honors of distinction, while idle farmers suffer the penalty of being denied peer standing.
checks.reason: 旌顯之賞 is a reward of conspicuous distinction and 不齒之罰 is exclusion from the ranks of peers; the replacement restores both specific terms.

checks.after: Again, assess the work to establish offices and the offices to appoint personnel, ensuring that offices meet needs and no one occupies a post in vain; estimate the annual revenue and set their salaries accordingly.
checks.reason: 量事置官 and 量官置人 are two separate staffing steps, and 度歲入多少，裁而祿之 sets salaries by estimated revenue; the replacement is complete and faithful.

checks.after: Yet though farming orders issue repeatedly, no two-thousand-bushel official or magistrate is intent on public diligence or keen to exhaust the land's advantage.
checks.reason: 莫有志勤在公、銳盡地利者 denies both diligence in public duty and zeal to exhaust the land's advantage; the old en merged the two into one vague phrase.

checks.after: Knowing this, Han's founder summoned and executed two-thousand-bushel officials by the tens for false reports of reclaimed fields, and under Ming and Zhang the age was called nearly peaceful.
checks.reason: 征殺 is summoning and then executing, 以十數 is counting by tens, and 號次升平 is 'was called nearly peaceful'; the replacement restores all three.

checks.after: Therefore Han's founder, knowing this, summoned and executed two-thousand-bushel officials by the tens for false reports of reclaimed fields, and in the Ming and Zhang era the age was called nearly peaceful.
checks.reason: Literal needs the same 征殺 and 以十數 corrections as the en, and the two-thousand-bushel rank is now named explicitly; the rest is unchanged.

checks.after: Since the Yongjia calamity the people have fled; the central plain is desolate, for a thousand li no smoke rises; hunger and cold bring ruin, and people fall one after another into the ditches.
checks.reason: 千里無煙, 饑寒流隕 and 相繼溝壑 are separate propositions that the abbreviated en omitted; the replacement includes all of them.

checks.after: Your Highness, with heroic and sage endowment, has been able to extend the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li of border and increased households by a hundred thousand, with achievements in following his predecessor’s footsteps and expanding the realm that surpass those of the great Earl of the West.
checks.reason: 繼武 means following in a predecessor's footsteps, 闡廣 means expanding, and 有高西伯 means the merit surpasses the Earl of the West's; 英聖 and 開境 are restored.

checks.after: Your Highness, with heroic and sage endowment, has been able to extend the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li of border and increased households by a hundred thousand, with achievements in following his predecessor’s footsteps and expanding the realm that surpass those of the great Earl of the West.
checks.reason: Literal 'continuing the merit of martial expansion' misreads 繼武 and 'rivaling' understates 有高; the replacement matches the corrected en.

checks.after: It is fitting to reduce and abolish the parks and settle the displaced on them.
checks.reason: 宜省罷諸苑，以業流人 is an advisory 宜 with both 省 (reduce) and 罷 (abolish), giving the displaced a livelihood; the replacement is faithful.

checks.after: Even Wei and Jin, though the Way faded, still did not cut the people by as much as seven or eight tenths; those farming with official oxen gave six parts to the state and four to the people, those with private oxen on official land split evenly with the state, and the people were secure and all rejoiced.
checks.reason: 削百姓不至於七八 means the exaction did not reach seven or eight tenths, which fits the six-four and even-split figures that follow; 'below' reversed it.

checks.after: Even Wei and Jin, though an age of fading Way, still did not cut into the people as far as seven or eight tenths; those who farmed with official oxen gave six parts to the state and four to the people; those with private oxen on official land split evenly with the state; the people were secure and all rejoiced.
checks.reason: Literal has the same 不至於七八 error; 'did not cut into the people as far as seven or eight tenths' is correct and nothing else changes.

checks.after: Now households approach a hundred thousand, crowded against the capital; I fear this will soon become a deep harm to the state. Divide their brothers and lineage and move them to western border cities, soothe them with kindness and restrain them with law, so they do not scatter among settled people and learn the state's strength and weakness.
checks.reason: 恐方將為國家深害 and 使不得散在居人 were omitted from the en, and 撫之以恩，檢之以法 is two separate methods; the replacement restores them.

checks.after: The central plain is not yet pacified and stores ought to be enlarged; official posts are numerous and idlers not few; when one man does not plow, hunger is suffered through the year.
checks.reason: 一夫不耕，歲受其饑 means that when one man does not plow, someone goes hungry through the year; 'makes the year hungrier' distorts it, and 未 and 宜 are restored.

checks.after: Now the central plain is not yet pacified and stores ought to be enlarged; official posts are numerous and idlers not few; when one man does not plow, hunger is suffered through the year.
checks.reason: Literal 'the year receives his hunger' personifies 歲; the replacement keeps the clause structure and gives the meaning correctly.

checks.after: Food must be taken from those who plow to feed them; one person consumes the labor of one person, and with tens of thousands living without working, the loss is likewise in the tens of thousands; how can every household be provided for and every person have enough, and government bring about peace!
checks.reason: 一人食一人之力 and 損亦如之 give the one-to-one burden scaled to tens of thousands, and 家給人足 needs both halves; the replacement restores both.

checks.after: Those with world-surpassing strategy and talent matching the age's needs may be placed in posts as required.
checks.reason: 經略出世 is outstanding, world-surpassing strategy, and 才稱時求 is talent matching the age's needs; the old en dropped half of the qualification.

checks.after: Those with world-surpassing strategy and talent matching the age's needs may be placed in posts as needed.
checks.reason: Literal 'world-ranging' understates 出世, which here means surpassing the age; the rest of the clause is unchanged and faithful.

checks.after: Your Highness is sage in nature, broad and clear, thirsting for counsel as for water; therefore men fully offer even rustic woodcutter counsel, offending yet not hiding.
checks.reason: 聖性, 若渴, the rustic counsel idiom 芻蕘 and 有犯無隱 (may offend but hides nothing) were thinned in the en; the replacement restores them.

checks.after: Your Highness is sage in nature, broad and clear, thirsting for words as for water; therefore men fully offer even the counsel of woodcutters and fuel-gatherers, offending yet not hiding.
checks.reason: 人盡芻蕘 is an idiom for offering even the humblest rustic counsel, not using up firewood and grass; the rest of the literal is kept.

checks.after: The responsible officials memorialized that they spoke demonic words offending superiors and brought them to law; Your Highness, merciful and broad in acceptance, pardoned their capital offense yet still demoted, barred, and excluded them from court.
checks.reason: 主者奏…至之于法, 慈弘苞納 and 削黜禁錮，不齒於朝 were under-covered in the en; the replacement matches the source and the literal.

checks.after: To punish remonstrating ministers while seeking straight words is like going north to reach Yue; how can there be any gain!
checks.reason: 豈有得邪 is the rhetorical conclusion to the north-to-Yue analogy and was dropped from the en; adding it is a real omission fix.

checks.after: It is fitting to measure what army and state require, set the number of posts, and return the rest to farming; teach them battle methods; students who after three years have no achievement should also return to farming; they must not vainly fill the authorized establishment and block the path of the keen and worthy.
checks.reason: 大員 here means the authorized establishment or quota, matching 置其員數, and the en's compressed commands lost 宜 and 聰俊之路; the replacement is faithful.

checks.after: It is fitting to measure what army and state require, set the number of posts, and return the rest to farming; teach them battle methods; students who after three years have no achievement should also return to farming; they must not vainly fill the authorized establishment and block the path of the keen and worthy.
checks.reason: 徒充大員 means vainly filling the authorized establishment, consistent with 員數 in the same sentence; 'great posts' misreads it.

checks.after: if not, punish and execute me at once, so the realm knows the court follows good like flowing water and punishes evil without delay.
checks.reason: 登 means at once and 罪戮 means punishment and execution, applied to the speaker himself; the old 'punish me' dropped both the immediacy and the execution.

checks.after: Agriculture is then the root of the state, yet two-thousand-bushel officials and county magistrates do not obey the first-month orders and do not urge lazy farmers; those especially who fail to open wasteland should be put under criminal law to awe and discipline the dependent cities.
checks.reason: 孟春之令, 惰農弗勸, 尤不修辟者 and 肅厲屬城 were missing from the compressed en; the replacement covers the full ordinance faithfully.

checks.after: Then farming is the state's root, yet two-thousand-bushel magistrates and county chiefs do not obey the first-month orders, and lazy farmers are not urged; those especially who do not open wasteland should be put under criminal law, to awe and discipline the dependent cities.
checks.reason: 尤不修辟者 means 'those especially who fail to open wasteland', not 'with blame on those'; the replacement also repairs the broken syntax faithfully.

additionalCorrections.before: Yuwen Gui sent Sheyiyu to hold Murong Han; Huang sent word: “Sheyiyu is fierce—spar lightly until he grows reckless, then strike.”
additionalCorrections.after: Yuwen Gui sent his cavalry general Sheyiyu with his whole host to resist Murong Han; Huang sent a rider with word to Han: “Sheyiyu is fierce and bold; you should give way to him a little, wait until the enemy grows arrogant, then take them.”
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 歸使其騎將涉奕於盡眾距翰，皝馳遣謂翰曰：「奕於雄悍，宜小避之，待虜勢驕，然後取也。」
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 小避之 means giving way a little, not 'spar lightly', and 盡眾 (his whole host) and 騎將 were omitted; the speaker and quotation owner are unchanged.

additionalCorrections.before: Cap tradesmen and aides to fixed quotas; everyone else goes back to the plow.
additionalCorrections.after: For the numbers of craftsmen and merchants, the four assistants and the column generals should quickly fix the authorized establishment; the rest return to farming.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 百工商賈數，四佐與列將速定大員，余者還農。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: The en makes the aides the thing being capped, but 四佐與列將 are the ones who set the 大員 quotas for 百工商賈; this matches how s0300 reads 大員.

additionalCorrections.before: Strike idle students from the rolls.
additionalCorrections.after: Students who are not fit for training and instruction are also to be removed from the rolls.
additionalCorrections.sourceQuote: 學生不任訓教者，亦除員錄。
additionalCorrections.sourceReason: 學生不任訓教者 names students unfit to bear instruction, not 'idle students'; 'idle' adds a reason the Chinese does not give.

cautions: s0233 至今太后發憤，一旦升遐 keeps its textual and temporal difficulty explicit: no emendation, no chosen death year and no conjectural replacement.

s0279 邇者/副 and s0291 意在無責 stay ambiguous as the packet records; they were not altered.
